name: maestro-career-studio
description: Tailor resumes and track applications, from your own machine
long_description: Drive Maestro Career Studio from Claude: capture and score jobs, tailor resumes against a job description, render PDFs, and track applications. Requires the Maestro CS stack running locally (docker compose up -d) — this extension talks to your own backend over Docker, and nothing leaves the machine.

container_name.title: Container name
container_name.description: The backend container to run the server inside. The default is correct unless you set COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME; check `docker ps` if unsure.

docker_path.title: Docker path
docker_path.description: Only needed if Docker is installed somewhere unusual. Claude Desktop runs extensions with a minimal PATH, so the usual locations are searched by absolute path; leave this empty unless that fails.

profile.title: Tool profile
profile.description: full (83 tools) or a scoped set: hunt, apply, explore, templates, career. Enable one at a time — the scoped profiles are subsets of full, so more than one costs context without adding capability.
